sections.heading: First Hour Checklist
items: Gather Wood, Stone, and Fiber immediately. You need about 30 Wood and 15 Fiber on you at all times to place a Bonfire and Tent.
Build a simple Campfire and bedroll to set a respawn point. Dying without one can spawn you across the map.
Eat two different foods before combat. Food buffs stack (up to two) and give HP regen, stamina, or damage bonuses.
Craft a Stone Pickaxe and Axe at the Workbench so you can mine ore and harvest larger trees.
Find a shoreline and build a small dock. Your first ship unlocks progression to other islands.

sections.heading: Core Survival Rules
items: Never tank hits. Windrose combat is souls-lite: dodge, block, then counter. Holding block drains stamina fast and leaves you staggered.
Watch the stamina bar. Sprinting, attacking, blocking, and swimming all drain it. Stop to recover before fights.
Keep a repair hammer and planks on your ship. Hull damage accumulates quickly in naval fights.
Use the map marker system. Place waypoints on resources and points of interest so you can return later.

sections.heading: Talents & Leveling
items: Press the progression/talent key (default D) to allocate points.
Early game: prioritize Toughguy tree for stamina and HP. Damage comes later once you can survive mistakes.
Look for fast-travel unlocks and comfort bonuses in the building/utility trees.
